function: CNN plus GNN network maps sub-6 GHz uplink pilots to the optimal near-field mmWave codeword (angle and distance indices) for analog beam selection in multiuser OFDM (pp. 8-10)
system: Sub-6 GHz BS (32 antennas, 5.5 GHz) plus co-located mmWave ELAA BS (256 antennas, 30 GHz, hybrid precoding); 8 users, one antenna per band; no RIS (pp. 4, 11)
method: Dual NMBEnets (angle, distance): CNN over subcarrier layers then GNN over users on a fully connected graph; supervised classification, cross-entropy loss, labels from exhaustive search (pp. 8-10)
data_channel: Wireless InSite ray tracing of the built-in MIMO Example scenario (Scenario 1, suburban intersection); 20,000 samples, 95% training and 5% validation (pp. 10-11, 14)
test_conditions: Main results in Scenario 1 (suburban); Figs. 20-21 test urban Scenario 4 and rural Scenario 8 after training on Scenario 1 or on other scenarios (pp. 14-15)
baselines: Exhaustive search (non-learned upper bound); learned FCNN [20], CNN [22] and DNBT-SC [28] with supplementary codeword tests (pp. 11-12)
metrics: Beam estimation accuracy, average sum rate per subcarrier, and effective sum rate that includes pilot overhead (pp. 11-14)
complexity: Per-layer parameter counts in Table II, from 6.14e3 to 1.17e6 (no total); no FLOPs or runtime reported (p. 12)
q1_support: p. 10: "The WI software employs ray tracing, a mathematical" technique; the channels come from the authors' own Wireless InSite runs on its built-in MIMO Example scenario, not from 3GPP TR 38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 15: "scenario (Scenario 1) and then applied to Scenario 4 or Scenario 8." and p. 15: "model was trained using data from a diverse set of scenarios (excluding the target scenario) and then applied to" the target scenario.
q3_support: p. 11: "1) Baseline 1: The exhaustive search scheme is adopted" as the non-learned comparison; p. 12: "with Baselines 2, 3 and 4 which are also based on deep" learning, the proposed scheme surpasses them in accuracy and sum rate (Figs. 13-17).
q4_support: p. 12: "NMBEnet PARAMETERS" is the caption of Table II, whose column of numbers of parameters lists the count per layer (6.14e3 to 1.17e6); no total, FLOPs or runtime is given.
q5_support: p. 11: "We generate a dataset of 20,000 samples for" training with its own Wireless InSite runs; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public channel dataset.
notes: Area 3: beam training selects the analog precoder codeword of the mmWave BS (Eq. 18, p. 6). q1 is borderline: the data come from commercial ray tracing (Wireless InSite) on its built-in MIMO Example scenario with the authors' own user placement, which is not on the list of standard models or public datasets, so it is graded 0; the reviewer should confirm. q4 rests on the per-layer parameter counts of Table II, read from the page image.
